funniiCalculator.description: A BPM and key calculator for planning harmonic and tempo relationships between tracks.

funniiChoir.description: A stacked-flanger ensemble that turns a single voice into a chorus of modulated resonant delay lines.

funniiClipper.description: A soft/hard clipper with adjustable drive and MIX blend, with a before/after scope display.

funniiCrush.description: A classic bitcrusher combining sample-rate reduction and bit-depth quantization.

funniiDelay.description: A stereo delay with independent DRY/WET control, feedback, and tempo-sync options.

funniiDoubler.description: A stereo doubler that creates width and depth through multi-voice detune and delay.

funniiEqualizer.description: A parametric equalizer with up to 50 bands, added by clicking anywhere on the visualizer.

funniiFormant.description: A pitch-independent formant shifter that reshapes a voice's resonant character without touching pitch.

funniiGate.description: A noise gate with adjustable threshold, attack, hold, and release, with a real-time gain-reduction visualizer.

funniiGlue.description: A bus compressor with glue-style compression and a DRY/WET blend for parallel compression.

funniiGoodizer.description: A one-knob multiband enhancer/maximizer in the spirit of Soundgoodizer, with four selectable characters.

funniiHaas.description: A Haas-effect stereo widener that delays one channel by a few milliseconds to shift perceived direction.

funniiKey.description: Detects the musical key and BPM of audio files and live input, with Camelot wheel notation.

funniiPan.description: A tempo-synced auto-panner with a fully drawable pan curve.

funniiPhase.description: Cascades up to 50 all-pass filters in series to disperse phase around a chosen frequency.

funniiPitch.description: A phase-vocoder pitch shifter with Â±12 semitone integer steps.

funniiRing.description: A ring modulator with adjustable carrier frequency, modulation depth, and DRY/WET blend.

funniiSynth.description: A wavetable synth with 2000+ procedurally-generated tables, an 8-slot mod matrix, and a piano-roll arpeggiator.

funniiTape.description: A tape-stop/tape-start effect that decelerates and re-accelerates the signal like a tape motor.

funniiVerb.description: An advanced 8-line feedback-delay-network reverb with shimmer and true infinite freeze.

funniiVolume.description: A gain-stage utility with a full EBU R128 loudness meter, mono/phase checks, and A/B trim comparison.

funniiWrite.description: A songwriter's notepad with a built-in rhyme engine.

funniiShare.description: Screen-shares your DAW's audio into Discord, Zoom, and Meet even when it's routed to a dedicated interface instead of your system's default output.
